instruction: A candid medium shot of an elegant indoor room with patterned wallpaper and wooden trim. On the left, the man in the dark blue suit (R1) stands in profile, looking directly at R2 while speaking. On the right, the bald man with glasses in the blue suit (R2) stands facing him, listening intently. They maintain a warm, double-handed handshake, clasping hands between them. Warm indoor lighting from a wall lamp illuminates the scene, creating soft shadows and a natural color palette.
elements: R1 is speaking to R2 while R2 listens during their handclasp
R2 is the attentive listener facing R1 rather than the speaker
R1 and R2 clasp hands between them in a warm double-handed handshake
R1 stands in profile looking directly at R2
R2 faces R1 while maintaining the handclasp
The scene is an elegant indoor room with patterned wallpaper and wooden trim
